subject: medicine
title: Systemic sclerosis, Sjogren syndrome and inflammatory myopathies

steps.tx: Ask about **Raynaud phenomenon** with white, blue then red colour change on cold exposure, plus fingertip ulcers from digital ischaemia. Record **skin tightening** with salt and pepper pigment, hidebound face and CREST features of calcinosis and telangiectasia. Clarify reflux with dysmotility, breathlessness from fibrosis or pulmonary hypertension, and renal crisis headache. Ask about gritty eyes with dry mouth, **muscle weakness** climbing stairs or combing hair, heliotrope eyelids with Gottron papules, and silica or solvent exposure.
steps.say: You should ask about colour change in the fingers on cold exposure because white, blue then red phases mark Raynaud phenomenon. Record skin tightening with salt and pepper pigment and a hidebound face. You should clarify reflux, chronic cough and breathlessness because dysmotility and lung fibrosis threaten organs. Ask about gritty eyes with dry mouth and weakness climbing stairs or combing hair. You should note eyelid rash with knuckle papules and ask about silica or solvent exposure.

steps.tx: Read the hand from little finger to index as **Raynaud sequence** moving from white pallor to blue cyanosis to red rubor. Note the small **digital ulcer** on the index fingertip, which marks severe ischaemia and needs urgent protection. Link these colour phases to cold triggered vasospasm in scleroderma and related diseases. Use the labels in exams to narrate pallor, cyanosis, rubor and ulcer in order and state what each phase means.
steps.say: Read the hand from the little finger to the index finger because the colours show pallor, cyanosis and rubor in sequence. Note the small fingertip ulcer because it marks severe ischaemia and needs urgent protection. Link these phases to cold triggered vasospasm in scleroderma and related diseases. Narrate the colours in order when you present the case because examiners reward a phased description.

steps.tx: Score **hidebound skin** with the Rodnan method across trunk and limbs, noting salt and pepper pigment and fingertip pitting. Inspect telangiectasia on lips and fingers, chalky calcinosis, ragged cuticles and nailfold loops with dropout on capillaroscopy. Identify **Gottron papules** over knuckles with sparing between joints, lilac heliotrope eyelids and shawl distribution rash. Test **proximal weakness** with shoulder and hip power while reflexes stay preserved, then check Schirmer dryness, dental decay with parotid swelling, and a water swallow test.
steps.say: Score skin thickness across the trunk and limbs and note salt and pepper pigment with fingertip pitting. Inspect the lips and fingers for telangiectasia and feel for chalky calcinosis. Examine the nailfolds for ragged cuticles and dropout loops on capillaroscopy. Identify knuckle papules with sparing between joints, lilac eyelids and a shawl rash. Test shoulder and hip power because proximal weakness with preserved reflexes marks myopathy, then check dryness, dental decay and swallowing.

steps.tx: Request **scl-70 antibody** for diffuse disease with lung fibrosis, and **centromere antibody** for limited CREST pattern with pulmonary hypertension risk. Add RNA polymerase testing when renal crisis threatens, Ro and La for dry eyes and mouth, Jo-1 for mechanic hands with lung disease, and Mi-2 for classic dermatomyositis rash. Check **muscle enzymes** with creatine kinase and aldolase, then confirm myopathy with irritable tracings on electromyography and biopsy. Separate lupus with malar rash, vasculitis with infarcts, scleromyxoedema with paraprotein, and inclusion body disease with finger flexor weakness.
steps.say: Request scl-70 antibody for diffuse disease with lung fibrosis and centromere antibody for limited CREST pattern. Add RNA polymerase testing when renal crisis threatens and Ro with La for dry eyes and mouth. Check Jo-1 for mechanic hands with lung disease and Mi-2 for classic rash. Measure creatine kinase and aldolase because leaking muscle enzymes confirm active myopathy. Confirm with electromyography and biopsy, then separate lupus, vasculitis, scleromyxoedema and inclusion body disease by their hallmark signs.

steps.tx: Protect digits with **Raynaud care** using calcium blockers and iloprost infusions for ulcers, plus warming and smoking avoidance. Guard the gullet with acid suppression and head up posture against aspiration, and treat **renal crisis** urgently with an ACE inhibitor because steroids can precipitate it. Slow **lung fibrosis** with mycophenolate or nintedanib, add steroid sparing agents for myositis, and moisten eyes and mouth with tears, saliva and pilocarpine. Prescribe physiotherapy with stretching and splints, and screen adult myositis for hidden malignancy. Follow skin, lungs and muscle together.
